name: Chichi Ninja Revolution ~Kanojo-tachi o Choukyou Seyo~
original_name: 乳忍者レボリューション ～彼女たちを調教せよ～
source:
The main character is a public officer. One day, he is suddenly transferred to the international information department. He doesn't know why, but he is ordered to take part in honey trap practice as a practice partner. Also, he gets to know that Akira, his cousin, is kidnapped by their enemy. He is given a new order and starts working on it....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081217105622/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011753]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
身为公务员的男主角某天突然接到调令，被派往国际情报部门任职。一头雾水的他刚一报到，便奉命在“色诱美人计”特训中充当女特工们的陪练搭档；与此同时，他还得知自己的表妹水野晶不幸落入敌手遭到绑架。随着新的密令下达，他当即投身于这项特殊任务之中……
